name: Stay Awake
tooltip.off:
Idle lock and screensaver are on
Left-click: stay awake
Right-click: stay awake for %1
tooltip.on:
Staying awake until turned off
Left-click: allow idle again
Right-click: stay awake for %1
tooltip.timed:
Staying awake for %1 more
Left-click: allow idle now
Right-click: %2
